Set a custom Chrome or Chromium executable path. By default Remotion will try to find an existing version of Chrome on your system and if not found, it will download one. This flag is useful if you don't have Chrome installed in a standard location and you want to prevent downloading an additional browser or need support for the H264 codec.

## CLI flag

```text
--browser-executable <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)
- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)
- [`remotion compositions`](/docs/cli/compositions)
- [`remotion browser ensure`](/docs/cli/browser/ensure)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)
- [`remotion gpu`](/docs/cli/gpu)
- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)
- [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)
- [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)
- [`remotion cloudrun still`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/still)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`ensureBrowser()`](/docs/renderer/ensure-browser#browserexecutable)
- [`getCompositions()`](/docs/renderer/get-compositions#browserexecutable)
- [`openBrowser()`](/docs/renderer/open-browser#browserexecutable)
- [`renderFrames()`](/docs/renderer/render-frames#browserexecutable)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#browserexecutable)
- [`renderStill()`](/docs/renderer/render-still#browserexecutable)
- [`selectComposition()`](/docs/renderer/select-composition#browserexecutable)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setBrowserExecutable('/usr/bin/google-chrome-stable');
```
